feeds.title: UF/IFAS Blog » Livestock
feeds.description: This section of our website features articles that have to do exclusively with livestock. The University of Florida Institute of Food and Agricultural Sciences (UF/IFAS) intends to educate, inform and provide updated information on UF/IFAS activities.

feeds.title: Pasture for Life News
feeds.description: Pasture for Life is a Certified 100% grass-fed meat, milk and dairy.The Pasture-Fed Livestock Association promotes the unique quality of produce raised exclusively on pasture, and the wider environmental and animal welfare benefits that pastured livestock systems represent.

feeds.title: Tri-State Livestock News
feeds.description: All aspects of agriculture are covered in Tri-State Livestock News. Information on grains, forages, sheep, hogs, dairy cattle, new and used farm. Tri-State Livestock News is the commercial cattlemens publication, located in the heart of one of the greatest beef cow/calf producing regions in the world..

feeds.title: Livestock & Poultry Middle East Magazine
feeds.description: Livestock & Poultry magazine is the only specialized magazine in English that covers quarterly all news relating to livestock & poultry breeding, horse breeding, aquaculture, beekeeping, feeds & feeding systems, storage, health & hygiene, housing, slaughterhouses, training, management systems, software, event and conferences in the Middle East and Asia.

feeds.title: West Texas Livestock Growers Blog
feeds.description: West Texas Livestock Growers is all about helping producers raise better animals. We provide timely issues and management tips that have the potential to affect the beef business and decision making process. The articles and tips here combine science and practical hands-on experience to provide ranchers with the information they need.

feeds.title: Farmtario » Livestock
feeds.description: Farmtario provides Ontario farmers with the most useful resources and information dedicated to the production of livestock in Ontario. We provide the most useful independent insight for Ontario farmers, including news, crop and livestock production, markets, and a deep understanding of how technology and data are being adopted on farms.

feeds.title: Alberta Farmer Express » Livestock
feeds.description: Alberta Farmer Express provides Alberta farmers and ranchers with the latest Livestock stories and features. Serving Canada's second-largest agricultural province, Alberta Farmer Express is widely recognized as the place where Alberta farmers and ranchers find out what's happening in agriculture, whether it's on local farms or farms around the world.

feeds.title: The Livestock Conservancy News
feeds.description: The Livestock Conservancy is a nonprofit membership organization. Our mission is to protect endangered livestock and poultry breeds from extinction. Included in our mission are over 150 breeds of donkeys, cattle, goats, horses, sheep, pigs, rabbits, chickens, ducks, geese, and turkeys.

feeds.title: Osborne Livestock Equipment News
feeds.description: Since 1973, Osborne Industries, Inc., has been leading the industry in the development, design, and manufacturing of innovative livestock and pig production equipment designed to facilitate informed management decisions, increase operational efficiency and improve producer profit. Read the latest livestock news and management solutions for hog producers and ranchers. Read more from Osborne here.

feeds.description: NETWORK DIGITAL LIVESTOCK

feeds.title: GALVmed Blog
feeds.description: GALVmed is a non-profit organization working to make livestock health products and medicines available, accessible, and affordable to small-scale producers in Africa and South Asia. Our mission is to make a real difference in the livelihoods of resource-poor livestock keepers by facilitating the provision of animal health tools within a sustainable economic framework.

feeds.title: Clemson University Livestock and Forages Blog
feeds.description: Clemson University Extension blog for the dissemination of livestock and forages-related scientific information.

feeds.title: The Livestock Project Blog
feeds.description: The Livestock Project is a place for learning and sharing ideas. Our mission is to shine a light on the challenges, concerns, and successes of non-conventional livestock and poultry farmers and those who support them. Follow and read the latest posts from The Livestock Project, about the challenges, concerns, and successes of non-conventional, organic, and alternative livestock and poultry farmers and those who support them.

feeds.title: Cornell University Beef Cattle Management Blog
feeds.description: Beef Cattle Management blog by Michael J. Baker - PAS, PhD, Beef Cattle Extension Specialist.

feeds.title: SoMo Farm & Ranch Supply » Livestock

Read blogs about Livestock written by some Farm and Ranch Supply, a premier pet food, pet supply, and livestock supply store.

feeds.title: Stellar Livestock Blog
feeds.description: Stellar Livestock (formerly Black Star Angus) is situated in Mudgegonga, near Myrtleford, in North East Victoria. Our goal is to produce quality bulls that offer maternal efficiency and carcase merit to commercial breeders.

feeds.title: Peter Jones Livestock Ltd Blog
feeds.description: Peter Jones Livestock Ltd was established in 2002 by Peter Jones and has grown rapidly to become one of the biggest privately owned livestock marketing consultancy companies in the UK. Peter has spent 30 years in the livestock marketing sector and has gained experience in the marketing of all categories of livestock and particularly cattle.

feeds.title: Farm4Trade Blog
feeds.description: Blog articles and news to better inform farmers. Livestock, breeding, production, technology and much more from world's farming best practices. Farm4trade develops solutions for farmers to help them recording information with the purpose of improving production, increasing trading opportunities and connecting with other farmers.

feeds.title: Farm Progress Magazine » Livestock
feeds.description: Explore the latest Cattle, hog, and other livestock news to enhance production, manage operations and offer market insight. Farm Progress is the largest, most diversified agriculture information business in North America. The magazine serves farm and ranch decision-makers by providing the information resources they need - news, analysis, events, data, research and broadcasting - to run successful operations and businesses.

feeds.title: High Plains Journal » Livestock
feeds.description: High Plains Journal is a weekly agriculture publication featuring timely ag news and markets, award-winning editorial, and an extensive farm and ranch classifieds.

feeds.title: Livestock247 Blog

feeds.title: Beef Magazine | Livestock

BEEF reaches the nation's top cow-calf operators, stocker-growers, cattle feeders, veterinarians, nutritionists, and allied industries, covering production, animal health, nutrition, finance, and marketing issues.

feeds.title: 3 Springs Land & Livestock Blog
feeds.description: 3 Springs Land & Livestock is creating healthier meat & a healthier planet simultaneously through regenerative agriculture. Soil health is our goal and that drives our decisions.

feeds.title: Farmers Weekly » Livestock

Get the latest livestock news on dairy and beef cattle, sheep, pigs, and alternative stock including deer and goats. See practical advice and case studies on breeding and fertility, nutrition and feed, grassland management, animal husbandry, livestock diseases, housing, and youngstock management.

feeds.title: Agro Bar-Magen Blog
feeds.description: ABMN is one of the world's largest producers and commodity importers in the animal health and nutrition industry. Established in 2009, the company has grown strongly over the last 13 years, bringing quality and scale of operation to unmatchable levels in the industry, with its large scale of production of feed additives and supplements, to cater to the nutritional needs of your livestock.
